glossary.definition: (A) "Naval stores" means spirits of turpentine and rosin.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3741.01 to 3741.07 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Spirits of turpentine" includes gum spirits of turpentine and wood turpentine.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3741.01 to 3741.07 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Gum spirits of turpentine" means spirits of turpentine made from oleoresin gum from a living tree.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3741.01 to 3741.07 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Wood turpentine" includes steam distilled wood turpentine and destructively distilled wood turpentine.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3741.01 to 3741.07 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Steam distilled wood turpentine" means wood turpentine distilled with steam from the oleoresin within or extracted from the wood.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3741.01 to 3741.07 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Destructively distilled wood turpentine" means wood turpentine obtained in the destructive distillation of the wood.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3741.01 to 3741.07 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Rosin" includes gum rosin and wood rosin.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3741.01 to 3741.07 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Gum rosin" means rosin remaining after the distillation of gum spirits of turpentine.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3741.01 to 3741.07 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Wood rosin" means rosin remaining after the distillation of steam distilled wood turpentine.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3741.01 to 3741.07 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (J) "Paint" includes oxide of zinc, red lead, and white lead, dry or in any kind of oil, and a compound intended for like use, colors ground in oil, paste, or semipaste paint, and liquid or mixed paint ready for use.
